notes: S3-FIX2 (decision 2026-11-18 #2): a valid zip container also holds the zero-data entry readable/x, which carries the DOS directory attribute (0x10) and whose name does not end with '/'. Only the final '/' makes a directory entry (§11.9 rule 4), so readable/x is a readable/ file that passed its entry checks: the container is valid and reports N_READABLE_PRESENT (§11.8, §14.6). The Rust verifier called the entry a directory entry and did not report the notice before the fix.
